subject: Re: CIW kickoff — robust training under label noise as a shared component
body:
Ximena,

Staffing: Leilani 50% (library extraction + API), Emeka 40% (benchmark harness), Giannis 30% (internal dataset integrations), Farah 25% (CI + release tooling through June).

Compute: day-to-day development fits on Titan best-effort. The July validation sweep is the big ask — noise types x noise rates x methods x seeds across CIFAR-10 and both internal sets. Ines confirmed our reservation on vulcan-h100 — 512 accelerators for the week of 2026-07-06 — which covers the full noise-sweep matrix in one shot. I've sized the matrix so it completes in 5 days with headroom, and cc'd Ines so the paperwork trail is in one place.

After the sweep we're compute-light through release.

Jelena
